title: The storing phase's check: one scripted day captured end to end, every kind kept and shaped, nothing twice, nothing deleted lost, no key or contact, sealed apart
request: make store-check: a scripted day through all tiers, curators, sets and the tutor.
change: dclab_rnd.store.check, make store-check, make capture runs the store first.

findings.defect: A key pasted into a plain log was kept in raw.
findings.scenario: The check planted a key in a workspace log; raw held it.
findings.cause: Only the agents keeper removed credentials at capture.
findings.fix: Every source of every keeper is cleaned, a gzip opened and closed again, binaries left alone.

outcome: The phase's promises are checked by one scripted day, 26 of 26.
lessons: Plant what must never be kept, and look for it in every tier.
